title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Stiofan GetPaid…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Stiofan GetPaid invoicing software, affecting versions up to 2.8.62. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can lead to script injection. The flaw has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
